creator: Infinite Arena Studio
inputDescription: A crackling electromagnetic pylon that shuts down technology around it
environmentalInteractions: Fighters with emp_field environment rules feel it immediately — powered walkers limp on backup hydraulics inside the radius.
Grants the emp_field context locally, which can also trigger env-tagged weaknesses on tech-dependent fighters standing inside it.
sideEffects: Suppresses BOTH teams' tech-tagged systems inside its 8 m radius — your own drones and armor die with theirs.
The spire itself is a priority target: enemy AI with tactical sense will focus it down.
counterplay: Destroy the pylon — 55 integrity does not survive concentrated fire for long.
Fight outside its 8 m radius; the field does not chase.
Draft low-tech fighters — beasts, elementals, and monks walk through the static untouched.
visualManifestation: A skeletal steel pylon wrapped in a crawling web of blue-white arcs; loose bolts and dropped blades twitch on the ground around it.
audioManifestation: A rising capacitor whine under constant crackling static; suppressed systems die with a descending power-down chord.
provenance: Curated Season 0 template: anti-tech suppression object archetype.
